description: The app page (served by the engine on loopback) may ask for its version, for updates, for the folder picker, to open a web link in the browser, to say it has drawn so the window can show, to raise a desktop notification and set the tray's needs-you count, and to move, minimise, maximise and close its own window, since it draws its own top bar (resizing from the edges is the shell's own). Nothing else of Tauri's.
